qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Operates dense regional grocery store networks across the US East Coast (Food Lion, Stop & Shop, Giant) and Benelux (Albert Heijn). While local scale provides distribution density, it does not confer an insurmountable cost moat or pricing power against Walmart, Aldi, or Costco. 5-year median GAAP ROIC (~6.0-6.4%) and operating margins (~2.6-3.7%) fail the Gate 3b 12% ROIC hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Proof of Moat & Pricing, REJECT). Regional grocery retailer operates in highly competitive US East Coast and European markets with razor-thin operating margins (2.5-4.0%). 5-year median GAAP ROIC of ~6.0-6.4% sits far below the 12% hurdle. Lacks pricing power above inflation against Walmart and discounters (Aldi/Lidl).
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median operating margin is 2.59% (annual range: 2.28% to 3.71% over 2020-2024). Multi-year GAAP ROIC has consistently tracked between 5.9% and 6.4%, far below the 12% threshold. Ongoing store closures at Stop & Shop reflect ongoing volume loss to price-competitive grocery rivals.
